description: Repeatable 6.00 u wide/deep middle bay. 25% wider deck than W1-r2; keel lowered to -2.75.
boundsNote: Measured 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation): union of the module's FBX vertex bounds, converted to authoring axes by the measured Blender-reimport rotation (authoring.x=-measured.y, authoring.y=measured.x, authoring.z=measured.z). Max Z 2.47 matches Midship_W1's exactly (rail top unchanged per kit README).

sockets.notes: Centre of the free-placement deck area of this bay (not an authored kit empty; carried over from the W1-r2 pattern for parity).

equipmentSlots.notes: Clearance = the REAL cannon footprint (art-staging/cannon-astra-v1: 1.22 wide x 2.18 long x 1.28 high), verified by WideHullValidation against this section's bounds and its crew passage (touches, does not overlap). CAVEAT: DeckSlot_0 and DeckSlot_1 on the SAME side overlap each other by 0.18 u in X if both carried a real cannon at once (pitch 2.0 u < the cannon's 2.18 u length); only one gun per side per bay is offered (capacity.gunSlots below).
Clearance = the REAL cannon footprint. See DeckSlot_0_-1 for the same-side adjacent-slot caveat.

Clearance = the REAL cannon footprint. See DeckSlot_0_-1 for the same-side adjacent-slot caveat.

PROVISIONAL free-placement area: the whole bay deck (length 6.00 x deck beam 11.60), height 2.66 unchanged from W1-r2 (headroom under a future raised deck). Equipment here reserves its own footprint; it must still keep out of the crew passage.

passages.notes: W2 has no authored crew passages (kit README); derived from W1-r2's passage rule scaled to the W2 deck (docs/WIDE-HULL-VALIDATION.md): |y| <= the deck-slot Y (4.35) minus half the real cannon's width (1.22/2=0.61) = 3.74, so sizeU.y = 7.48. X span (the whole bay, 0..6.00) and height 3.4 u (1.7 m crew) unchanged from W1-r2.

hydrostatics.notes: Astra 2026-09-24 (art-staging/modular-hull-wide-v1/hydrostatics/Midship_W2.json): Hull_Shell only, upright level flotation. Cross-checked by WideHullValidation against the trapezoid area of the interfaces.json Hull_Shell profile x 6.00: 294.82 vs table's 294.84 U^3 (0.005%).

lightship.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation): today's W1-r2 Long lightship (31906.6 kg) x the W2/W1 Long hydrostatic-table volume-to-deck ratio (940.54 / 611.67 U^3 = 1.5377), split by this section's own table volume to the deck (294.84 / 940.54 U^3). See hull.stern.w2r1.v1's lightship.rule for why the volume ratio was chosen over the surface-area ratio.

holdCells.source: round(this section's table volume-to-deck (294.84 U^3) / W1-r2's volume-per-hold-cell (611.67/16=38.229 U^3))

berths.source: floor(W1-r2 middle's 4 berths x the W2/W1 deck-area ratio 11.60/9.28=1.25)

gunSlots.source: Both slots pass the real-cannon clearance/passage check (WideHullValidation); this is the same DeckSlot index W1-r2's middle designates, kept for consistency (no existing W2 ship to match a gun position to). DeckSlot_0 is left off to avoid the same-side adjacent-slot overlap noted on those slots.

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation), mirroring the W1-r2 A4 seeding: PROVISIONAL, tune freely; the shipyard sums whatever is here.

physical.notes: NOT AUTHORED. Must not be inferred from mesh size, section length or wheel radius.
